the Grass to Startle the Snake</i></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: large;">During
the Tang Dynasty, in present-day Anhui Province, there was an
unpopular magistrate called Wang Lu whose bookkeeper received a
letter from the local people accusing him of corruption. It is said
that Wang Lu wrote on the letter 'by merely beating the grass, you
have startled the snake within'. This might have been his
acknowledgment of a ploy, to show he was ready to fight back. Or,
perhaps it meant that the strategy had worked as a warning to him
that his corruption would not be tolerated.</span></p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, serif;"><i><span style="font-weight: normal;">Beat
the Grass to Startle the Snake</span></i></span> is associated with
the 24th hexagram, <i>Earth over Mountain</i>. The weak lines have
pushed the strong lines out of hexagram, and a new strong line
appears. It is subtle, not drawing attention, waiting to gather more
strong lines to itself before moving forward to strike [1], [28].</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: large;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: large;">&nbsp;</span>

	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	11)  <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我有几个朋友是经济学家。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	12) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">经济现在很不好，我不想多花钱。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	13) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">在这里，没文化的人赚的钱最多。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	14) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">这个城市没有自己的文化，在这里的都</span></span>
    <span lang="zh-CN">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;是外地人。</span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	15) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">政治很无聊，我最喜欢看历史的书。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	16) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">这个房子很老，所以虫子很多。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	17) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我不喜欢他们，他们不友好。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">18)</span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: times;"> </span></span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">那个响声惊动了森林里的小动物。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	19) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我们有安排去海边。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	20) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我习惯不了这里的天气。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	21) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">在中国的文化里，你不可以反对你的老</span></span>
    <span lang="zh-CN">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;板。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	22) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">发生了什么？他看起来很不好。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	23) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">他的电脑看起来和我的很像。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	24) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你又忘带雨伞了。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: large;"><span lang="en-US">2</span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: large;"><span lang="en-US">5</span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif; font-size: large;"><span lang="en-US">)</span></span><span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif" style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	</span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: large;"><span lang="zh-CN">我忘记买牛奶了，我还要再去一次超</span></span>
    <span lang="zh-CN">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;市。</span></span></p>
</div>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<br /></p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><style type="text/css">p { margin-bottom: 0.1in; direction: ltr; color: #000000; line-height: 120%; orphans: 2; widows: 2; background: transparent }p.western { font-family: "Liberation Serif", "Times New Roman", serif; font-size: 12pt; so-language: en-US }p.cjk { font-family: "Noto Sans CJK SC Regular"; font-size: 12pt; so-language: zh-CN }p.ctl { font-family: "FreeSans"; font-size: 12pt; so-language: hi-IN }a:link { color: #000080; so-language: zxx; text-decoration: underline }</style></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><a href="https://apecrank.blogspot.com/2011/03/notes-from-china-chapter-12-lead-away.html">Previous Chapter</a></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><a href="https://apecrank.blogspot.com/2011/03/notes-from-china-chapter-14-borrow.html">Next Chapter</a><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></p>
